(I have had a history of frequent UT and kidney infections). The receptionist said I could bring one in so I did only to find the surgery closed no doubt for lunch. I couldn't go back as I had to go visit my terminally ill mother in Scunthorpe hospital so was only able to take the sample again at 4.45. Only to be told by the receptionist that there was no one available to test it and that I would have to go to Cromwell Road.

In the last year i have frequently been into the surgery to find NO-ONE waiting and receptionists sat behind their desk, no phone calls or face to face patient communications.

Staff at Scunthorpe hospital have been fantastic with my mother whilst being rushed off their feet...no doubt some of the patients in A and E waiting to be seen as they are not receiving an appropriate service from their GP.

This surgery whilst nicely refurbished and pristine is letting its patients down.
